checks.name: default renderer is exercised without opting into regional terrain
ready target is exposed without claiming missing root coverage
ready target activates collision readiness immediately
newly exposed target has matching physical terrain
late coarse parent cannot withdraw the target or overlap its surface
in-progress edit keeps the old cut until atomic publication
ready neighbour joins without waiting for unrelated siblings
neighbouring fine surfaces share exact native boundary vertices
both sides of the grid edge are covered by published fine colliders
previously covered root remains intact until all replacement coverage is ready
complete and partial roots retain distinct loading readiness
hidden fine collision cannot falsely declare an existing coarse region ready
dirty visible parent remains live during edit preparation
stale hidden parent cannot resurrect over current fine terrain

scope: Default production stream coverage, native meshes and physics; no scheduling or rendered latency assertion.
